title: Not impressed after the 1st box
text: 1st box was great. 2nd box was mediocre.  Couldn’t see the value for $20.  Kid likes the novelty of getting an envelope in the mail, but for the cost, I feel it’s over priced.  Going to go 1 more month, if it’s as mediocre as the 2nd box I will cancel.  $60 for 3 months of boring printout of crosswords and a trinket, no thanks.  Definitely worth the 1st box if you want to try.  After that meh..!
label: neutral
